title: Agent Session (v2)
description: Session record returned by POST /api/v2/sessions and GET /api/v2/sessions/{id}. SPEC-022 R-1 adds workspace fields: server-minted title, last_active_at, parked-confirmation flag, and a best-effort transcript reconstructed from the kernel state snapshot. SPEC-025 R-2 adds the additive evidence_turns field carrying persisted tool evidence grouped by assistant turn. SPEC-024 R-3 adds the additive model field carrying the session's pinned model id. SPEC-031 R-2 adds the additive confirmations field carrying durable confirmation lifecycle cards. SPEC-037 R-4 adds the additive executions array under each confirmation card carrying signed execution request/receipt rows. SPEC-051 R-6 adds the additive flow_summary on each confirmation card carrying the bound browser-flow headline so durable cards render the same workflow framing as the live operator card.

title.description: Server-minted title (first user turn, capped at 80 characters); null for sessions created before SPEC-022.

last_active_at.description: Last chat-turn activity marker used for workspace ordering.

pending_confirmation.description: True while the session holds an unresolved parked HITL confirmation (SPEC-020 registry state).

model.description: Model id pinned on the session by the most recent turn (SPEC-024 R-3); null when the session never selected a model. Resolution order for new turns is request model > pinned model > deploy-time default.

transcript_available.description: False when no transcript could be recovered from the kernel state snapshot; the transcript array is then empty.

evidence_turns.description: Persisted tool evidence grouped by assistant turn (SPEC-025 R-2); empty array when the session stored none, null when the evidence store is unreadable (degrades like transcript_available=false, never 500). Turn shape per session-evidence.schema.json; frames follow the tool_call/tool_result shapes of agent-stream-event.schema.json.

confirmations.description: Durable confirmation lifecycle cards for the owner transcript (SPEC-031 R-2), ordered by parked_at ascending; empty array when the session parked none, null when the record store is unreadable (degrades like evidence_turns, never 500). Decided records carry the decider and outcome so cards render read-only with attribution after any re-login. SPEC-033 R-2 adds the additive turn_index field carrying the parking turn ordinal.

turn_index.description: SPEC-033 R-2: ordinal of the user turn that parked the record (same convention as evidence_turns.turn_index), so transcript seeding anchors the card under its parking exchange; null for records parked before the column existed.

flow_summary.description: SPEC-051 R-6: card-level browser-flow headline captured at park time (skill intent, origin, risk_class) so the durable confirmation card renders the same workflow framing on the approver inbox and the owner transcript as the live operator card; null for non-browser cards and for records parked before the column existed.

executions.description: SPEC-037 R-4: signed execution rows for this confirmation, one per approved parked call, in requested_at order; empty for pending/denied/expired records and for decided rows that predate signed execution requests.

digest_match.description: Whether the invoked arguments matched the signed request's argument digest; true for executed receipts, false on a digest-mismatch rejection, null when verification never ran.

reject_reason.description: Invocation-boundary rejection reason (signing_unavailable, args_digest_mismatch, request_missing) when status is rejected.

receipt.description: Signed execution receipt envelope per execution-receipt.schema.json once the execution closed; null while requested or rejected.
